Identity: name + phone 7135550142 (+ SSN4 4417). Authorisation: "happy for the agent to do whatever service work on their side is needed"; the transfer is hers — she confirms it herself with plan reference, amount and sequence the agent gives. Simulator is passive (answers if asked; executes the handed-over user tool).

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse

### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Tier review of payday 2026-10-15.** Scope: latest period close pay date 10-15; no shortfall carries a pay date on or after LED 10-01 (only 08-31) → tier review, not missed-recovery ("a plan with such a shortfall is reviewed under the missed-recovery review instead"). Due: LED 10-01 on or before 10-15; payroll deduction recovery 92.99 carrying 10-15 is on the plan (entry 10-20); no write-off; today is after the payday. Outcome (tier_review_outcome_rule): no write-off → no reset; open shortfall = 373.97 − (60+75+90+140) − 8.97 = 0.00 → none → move up one tier (Plus → Preferred) iff Preferred within every allowance:
- tenure allowance: hire 2026-02-09 → payday 2026-10-15 = 248 days → "180 to 364 → Premier" ✓;
- earnings allowance: period closes with pay date in the last six months 694.73+839.76+729.76+845.17+685.01+986.95 = 4781.38 → "3000.00 to 5999.99 → Preferred" ✓;
- recovery-count allowance: 6 paydays closed in 12 months; one shortfall, reason deduction not taken → "every one … deduction not taken → the number of those paydays" = 6 → "6 to 9 → Preferred" ✓;
- write-off allowance: none → Premier Plus ✓.
Result: new tier **Paystride Access Preferred**, level_effective_date **2026-10-16** (day after payday reviewed).
Fall-back (no allowance documents found): outcome rule alone also moves up one tier → Preferred — the fall-back equals the answer for this seed (noted for step 2; the nearest wrong reading — recovery count as paydays less shortfalls = 5 → Plus allowance → no move — is excluded by the recovery_record ladder's first method).

**(b) Bank transfer amount (tier Preferred, the new tier applying to transfers booked from 10-16).** Scope: one plan; configured 60 ≥ bank transfer percentage 54 (below) → schedule applies.
- Bank accrued net (lines carrying 10-30, lag 0 on Preferred; none dated today): regular employer-reported 8×92.63 = 741.04; regular estimated-from-gross 3 lines (gross 342.00) valued by gross-only estimate method: 7 employer-reported regular lines carrying the latest close pay date 10-15, no zero gross → own ratio 648.41/798.00 → 342.00×ratio = 277.89 (rounded down once); shift differential 3×7.31 = 21.93; overtime 2×55.58 = 111.16 × overtime share one half (exactly one correction with work date in last two months: 10-06; the 07-28 one is 2 whole months back) = 55.58; card tips 166.46 × tips share three quarters (2 card tips lines carry 10-15) = 124.845; less correction 9.26 → **1212.025**.
- Bank transfer percentage: Preferred 50 + card wage points 10 (active card, 4 payroll loads in last two months) = 60, × tenure share 90 percent (254 days hire→today) = **54**; open shortfall 0 → no shortfall multiplier.
- Bank period taken 365.00. Rooms: percentage 0.54×1212.025 − 365 = 289.4935; pay-period 750 − 365 = 385.00; day 300 − 0 = 300.00; largest single 300.00; no loan → no deduction-ceiling room. Lowest 289.4935.
- Return share one half (return booked 2026-08-04, 2 whole months back) acting last: 144.74675 → rounded down **144.74**.
- Fall-back (computation document only, on Preferred): 0.50×1270.73 − 365 = 270.365 → **270.36** (definite, different).

**(c) Bank transfer fee.** Scope: latest transfer of the day (the new one, daily sequence 1), next business day to bank account, worker_paid. First bank transfer of period (only bank transfer carrying 10-30) → baseline "no fee"; free-first allowance: 4 other transfers carry 10-30 → "four or more … carries the fee like any other". Fee charged: settlement-timing — confirmed after 17:00 on a Wednesday → 1.49 − 0.50 = 0.99; band surcharge 100.01–250.00 → +0.25 = 1.24; room (pay-frequency cap method, semimonthly): 9.99 × 15/14 = 10.703571 − 8.97 = 1.733571 → not binding → **1.24** (half up). Fall-back (computation document only): first bank transfer → **no fee** (definite, different).

Factor findability (record words → document): estimated_from_gross net basis → "Valuing Gross-Only Earnings Lines"; card_tips / overtime_hours lines and timecard_correction → "Card Tips … Bank Accrued Net", "Overtime Earnings and Timecard Corrections"; hire_date → "Tenure Share for Bank Transfers"; transfer return reason returned_by_receiving_institution → "Returned-Funds History"; card account + payroll loads (Paystride Visa Payroll Card) → "Card Wage Points"; other transfers carrying the pay date → "Free First Bank Transfer Allowance"; requested_time after 17:00 → "Settlement-Timing Pricing"; amount band → "Bank Transfer Amount Bands and Surcharges"; pay_frequency semimonthly → "Measuring the Fee Ceiling by Pay Frequency"; tier review allowances from hire date, period close lines, shortfalls, write-offs. ### 6. Problem tree (visible materials only)
- Root: bank transfer (worker's own write).
- Hop A (state-derived): bank_transfer_amount_and_request — "The bank transfer amount is worked out only after the plan's level effective date falls after the pay date of its latest period close line, where it has one, that pay date is before today and no shortfall carries a pay date on or after the level effective date." Records: LED 2026-10-01, latest close pay date 2026-10-15 (< today), no shortfall ≥ 10-01 → state not met. Search with the sentence's words ("level effective date", "latest period close", "no shortfall … on or after") → tier_review_desk_reference: scope "when no shortfall carries a pay date on or after the plan's level effective date", effect "that day is recorded as the level effective date" (the day after the payday reviewed → 10-16 > 10-15). So the tier review write brings the state about. Its own due-rule is satisfied (settlement on plan, no write-off, day after payday).
- Hop B (state-derived): bank_transfer_fee_booking — "The bank transfer fee is booked only after the next-business-day bank transfer it prices stands on the plan's ledger as today's latest transfer entry." The transfer entry is brought about by the worker's request tool (bank_transfer_amount_and_request capability "books one transfer entry on the plan").
- Order: tier review → worker transfer → fee. No hop pre-solved: no document names another problem's tool, a route or a chain.

### Counter-proofs
- "Do only what she asked" (book the transfer straight away on Plus): excluded — the amount "is not worked out while the level effective date is on or before that pay date"; on Plus the numbers would also differ (percentage 40+10 → 45; ceilings 500/250/200).
- Missed-recovery review instead of tier review: excluded — its scope needs "a shortfall carries a pay date on or after the plan's level effective date"; only 08-31 exists.
- Card destination: excluded by the customer and by scope (bank schedule governs bank transfers only).
- Instant to debit card instead: the customer wants bank; the instant schedule is the other branch.
- Fee from base listed fee (1.49 capped by 11.99/9.99 period cap) / first-transfer free: excluded by free-first allowance (4 others) and settlement-timing note.
- Fee room as biweekly (9.99 − 8.97 = 1.02 → fee 1.02): excluded by the pay-frequency method (semimonthly row) — non-binding difference detectable: under biweekly the fee would be 1.02, so the frequency factor bears weight here.

Soft spot recorded (not decided here): "payroll settlement" in the review due-rule is not defined in the access corpus; I read it as the payroll deduction recovery carrying that payday (entry 2026-10-20, pay date 2026-10-15). No program_settlements rows exist for this agreement.
